verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is documented only as a CLI (git, dir and stdin commands), a pre-commit hook and a GitHub Action. The evidence shows no documented programmatic API, such as an HTTP/REST API or a documented library interface, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. A scanning tool could plausibly expose such an API, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows Gitleaks delivers one.
